Output the digest text only.

- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: The AI agent landscape is rapidly maturing, transitioning from experimental phases into robust, real-world production environments. Open-source frameworks have hit a significant milestone as adoption triples, driven by model-driven agents that quietly replace hand-coded orchestration within modern startups. Meanwhile, tool-calling reliability has officially emerged as the new benchmark for frontier models, ensuring more precise and autonomous execution. Multi-agent swarms are also advancing rapidly, moving from simple demonstrations to fully regulated enterprise workflows. To support this complex deployment, observability standards are finally emerging, enabling end-to-end tracing of agent decisions and fostering greater trust in autonomous systems.
